title: When Generated Images Look Right and Retrieve Wrong: Coverage-Guided Cross-Scale Re-Indexing for Knowledge-Faithful Generative Perception
abstract: arXiv:2608.20810v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal information systems increasingly route generated visual content back through the same vision-language index that informed its production, so the output must remain retrievable by the queries it was meant to serve. When the scene contains entities at vastly different scales, existing language-guided generators condition on a single, globally pooled text embedding and quietly drop scale-specific concepts, breaking concept-query retrieval even when pixel fidelity is high. We formalise this failure as semantic collapse and propose CERES, a closed-loop multimodal indexing framework that builds a three-level semantic pyramid, mines implicit concepts via a co-occurrence-aware router, performs scale-routed cross-attention into a lightweight U-Net generator, and verifies coverage by re-indexing the generated image with the same frozen VLM. A continuously differentiable soft-Jaccard coverage objective returns dense gradients to the 0.

translated_title: 当生成的图像看起来正确但检索出错：基于覆盖引导的跨尺度重索引实现知识忠实生成感知
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20810v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：多模态信息系统越来越多地将生成的视觉内容路由回生成其生产所依据的同一视觉语言索引，因此输出必须仍能被其预期服务的查询检索到。当场景包含尺度差异极大的实体时，现有的语言引导生成器仅基于单一的全局池化文本嵌入进行条件化，并悄然丢弃尺度特定概念，即使像素保真度很高也会破坏概念查询检索。我们将这种失败形式化为语义坍缩，并提出CERES，一种闭环多模态索引框架，该框架构建三级语义金字塔，通过共现感知路由器挖掘隐含概念，执行尺度路由的交叉注意力进入轻量级U-Net生成器，并通过使用相同的冻结视觉语言模型对生成的图像进行重索引来验证覆盖度。一个连续可微的软Jaccard覆盖目标将密集梯度返回给0。
tldr: 本文提出CERES框架，通过三级语义金字塔和覆盖引导重索引，解决多尺度场景下生成图像语义坍缩导致的检索失败问题，确保生成内容在概念查询下保持可检索性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CERES, a coverage-guided cross-scale re-indexing framework that addresses semantic collapse in multi-scale generated images, ensuring concept-query retrievability via a three-level semantic pyramid and soft-Jaccard coverage objective.
